description: Full details for one marketplace tool: actions with their inputs, an example, price, seller and health, plus the exact next step. For a paid tool the next step is pay_offering with its offeringUrl, then use_paid_offering with toolName and toolArguments. For a free tool it is run_free_tool, which needs no sign-in. Pass slug or the tool page URL. Related: search_tools, run_free_tool, pay_offering, use_paid_offering.

slug.description: Tool slug from search_tools, e.g. pathguard.
